text: The plastic clips snapped the first time I tightened the straps. Replaced them with metal buckles from the hardware store myself.
Buckle broke on day one. For the price I expected better hardware.
Both clips cracked in cold weather. Cheap plastic garbage.
Zipper jammed and then the pull tab snapped off within a week.
Straps fine but every buckle has now failed. Third one snapped loading the ute.
Advertised as waterproof but a light shower soaked everything inside. Canvas feels thin.
Material is way too thin for touring. Rain got in through the seams on night two.
Jump starter died after four uses. Battery will not hold charge. Avoid their electrical gear.
Fridge stopped working in week three. Total junk electronics.
Asked for a warranty replacement and they wanted a 10% restocking fee. Customer service never replied for two weeks.
Courier lost it twice and the delivery company blamed me. No response from support.
My first one was great so I ordered a second one and it is nowhere near the same quality. Hit and miss.
Decent unit overall. Colour faded a bit in the sun after a summer up north.
Cheap jigs rusted to bits after two sessions. The prongs bent on the first squid.
Whole thing fell apart, cloth peeled and the hooks were corroded inside a month.
Rusty crown after one rinse. Never again with the $2 specials.
These sink like a stone, nose dive straight down. Had to trim the weight myself to fix the fall rate.
Butt first sink attitude, squid completely ignore it. Binned the lot.
One out of the pack spins on the drop. Line twist killed the session, tow point was bent out of the box.
Wet jigs went back in the bag and the whole kit stinks now, hooks tangle into one rusty ball. Storage is the real problem nobody solves.
My tackle bag smells like death, no way to dry out the jigs. Would pay for proper storage.
Colours look nothing like the photos on the website.
